notes: Total 60 as published. Marked '(starting)': Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Uh-oh! (the strategy: "Your starting effect should be Uh-Oh") and the 'The Signal x3' line; The Signal is not set as a starting interrupt.
Posted 'Wortt' dested the Jabba's Palace creature Worrt; 'Uh-oh' Uh-oh!; 'Han' the Jedi Pack character Han (Jedi Pack); Do, Or Do Not is the Dagobah Effect (no Defensive Shields in 2000).

The strategy lists the changes from the author's first version (out: a mining droid, 2 Timer Mines, a Mechanical Failure, Anger, Fear, Aggression, Never Tell Me The Odds, Transmission Terminated; in: 2 Throw Me Another Charge, a Don't Forget The Droids, 2 Worrt, 2 It Can Wait); the list above is version 2 as posted.
